result.title: ArtLang-4D: Articulation-Aware Dynamic Language Fields from Monocular Videos
result.summary: Language that describes an articulated object is often about its state: the drawer pulled out the furthest, the door opened halfway, push the drawer all the way in. Existing 3D language fields attach one feature to each point and cannot tell these descriptions apart, and 4D language fields condition on video time, which has no kinematic meaning and cannot be set by a user. We present ArtLang-4D, which reconstructs an articulated object from a single monocular RGB-D video and equips it with a dynamic language field indexed by articulation time t, the normalized state of its joints, instead of video time. The geometry is a canonical triangle field whose triangles follow typed screw joints, discovered from the video without any joint initialization. The language field is supervised by a t-tagged caption bank that describes each part with comparative state phrases in a whitened open-vocabulary text space. A free-form query is answered by maximizing part relevance jointly over parts and states, which returns both the part and the articulation state it describes; a command is then executed by moving only that part along its recovered joint. On the 100 objects of Articulate-100, ArtLang-4D recovers more accurate joints and part geometry than reconstruction and articulation baselines, retrieves the queried state far more reliably than a state-agnostic language field, and executes language commands with lower motion error.

AI.brief_summary: 论文从单目 RGB-D 视频重建带类型的螺旋关节铰接物体，并构建以「铰接时间」t（关节归一化状态）而非视频时间为索引的动态语言场，用比较状态短语标注的 caption bank 监督；查询时在部件与状态上联合最大化相关性以同时返回部件及其状态，并按恢复的关节执行命令，在 Articulate-100 上评测关节与几何精度、状态检索及动作误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以有运动学意义的状态量取代原始时间作表示索引」及部件—状态联合检索的表述，可能与 LVR 中推理状态索引、视觉证据筛选与状态抽象问题形成概念对照，但领域距离较远，可迁移性尚需核查。
